svg.title: A Foundry resource and its projects
svg.desc: An Azure subscription contains a resource group, which contains a Foundry resource. The resource holds model deployments, connections, networking and security, and usage metrics, shared by every project. Inside it are the default project, the resource's first project, which alone supports the full OpenAI API, OpenAI Batch and OpenAI fine-tuning, and any projects you add later, which get the Responses, Files and Conversations APIs. Each project holds agents, files, evaluations, datasets and indexes, and has its own access control.

g.text: Projects use the resource's deployments and connections
Full OpenAI API · Batch · OpenAI fine-tuning
Optional; for example one per team or app
